user_query: I'm planning a family gathering and I need some entertainment options. Can you recommend some fun radio stations that cater to different musical tastes? Additionally, I would like to download some tracks from YouTube to create a customized playlist for the event.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of fun radio stations that cater to various musical tastes.
Outline different musical genres and match the radio stations to those genres to ensure variety.
required_inputs: List of radio stations from Task 1

TaskList.description: Identify popular tracks available on YouTube for download.
Download the selected tracks from YouTube to create a customized playlist.
Combine the radio station information and the customized playlist for the family gathering.
required_inputs: List of radio stations from Task 2
